options.idea: Hymn of rising hope: stepwise bass climbs two octaves from Am to C, darker middle, brass arrival.
options.name: Rising Hymn

why.chords: Am | G7/B | C | Dm | Em | Fmaj7 | G | C
why.principle: Rising bass lifts major tune toward hope, slow changes breathe
why.what: Cello Double Bass sing rising bass, Horns hold chords, Harp arpeggiates

why.chords: C | Dm | Em | F | G | F/A | G/B | C G/B
why.principle: Repeat varied with new counterline and brighter harmony underneath
why.what: Oboe countermelody answers, Bassoon adds rocking figure, Bass continues rise

why.chords: Fmaj7 | G7 | Am | F | G | Am | C | Gsus4 G
why.principle: High tune floats over moving inner line, dominant waits
why.what: Cellos sing inverted motif, Horns sustain, Glockenspiel lights peaks

why.chords: Am | F | Dm | E7 | Am | F | Dm | E7
why.principle: Darker relative minor delays hope, sequences build tension
why.what: Oboes trade fragmented motif, Bassoons sequence, Harp drives

why.chords: F | C/E | F | G | C | F | G | C
why.principle: Full forces arrive late, plagal then perfect closes home
why.what: Trumpets fanfare answer, Trombones sustain, Timpani Cymbals crown arrival

options.idea: Pale tune sinks into A-minor lament, low voices fall stepwise to hard-won minor close.
options.name: Lament in A minor

why.chords: Am | Dm | Am/C | F | Em | Am | Dm E | E
why.principle: Low steps against tune darken major to minor
why.what: Cellos basses hold lament, bassoons rock, horns sustain

why.what: Bassoons invert opening cell, cellos sequence down, horns answer
